notes.title: Early worm released!
notes.content:
Hello Power hover players! 

We just released a new game on Steam: Early worm. It's is family friendly physics based platformer. 
It's our second release on Steam but not the last! We are also hard at work on the Rallygator, which will hopefully be released sometimes next year.  
 https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27237643/11a94a82f5c07646062b13838062907d716fe92e.gif
Are you the Early Worm that catches the apple?

Thanks for playing our games!

-Markus

notes.title: Update is live!
notes.content:
Power hover update is now live! 
Fixes Xbox 360 controller sensitivity issue.
Adds Xbox one controller to supported controllers. 

Pause ui item is no longer visible during gameplay. Access pause menu with "Pause" button on controller or esc on the keyboard. 

Happy playing!

notes.title: Power hover update and sale.
notes.content:
In next update we will take a look at the xbox controller sensitivity issue. Thre's also few other minor issues that need fixing. 

Game is also on weekly sale -50% off! Now is a good change to get the game :)

-Markus

Launch week is over and here's a small media recap.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z4aT0Koc7HQ
Kathrine of Sky did a nice lets play series:

Written:
Got mention from PC gamer: 
http://www.pcgamer.com/new-steam-games/?utm_content=buffer915f8&utm_medium=social&utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=buffer-pcgamertw

Hope everyone is enjoying the game! If you have any questions head to the discussion board!
